page: Microsoft Azure F8-4amds_v7 is a virtual machine configuration utilizing dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processors clocked at up to 4.5 GHz. The instance provisions 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs with single-threading enabled, supported by 48 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory allocation of 16.0 GB per core, along with a bundled 945 GB local NVMe SSD. Hardware virtualization is delivered via Microsoft Hyper-V, and the processor includes support for AVX-512 vector extensions, bfloat16, and cryptographic acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core compute and data manipulation capabilities. In stress-ng single-core tests, the instance scored in the top 10 percent with 3541.48 points, mirrored by top-tier single-threaded compression throughput of 38.57 GB/sec in gzip and 16.95 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. Multi-core performance aligns with the middle 50 percent at 14063.2 in stress-ng, reflecting the 4-core physical count. Memory subsystem testing registered read-only small-block cached bandwidth of 803.46 GB/sec and uncached large-block throughput of 52.32 GB/sec.

The combination of high clock frequency, large per-core memory capacity, and fast local NVMe storage creates a well-rounded operational profile for memory-intensive workloads that require sustained per-thread speed rather than broad thread counts. With 12.51 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks, this configuration fits in-memory caching tiers, relational database instances, stateful ETL processing, and search index services requiring low-latency local scratch disk.
description: Microsoft Azure F8-4amds_v7 is a cloud server configuration featuring 4 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at 4.5 GHz. The VM includes 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding an elevated 16.0 GB of memory per core, alongside a integrated 945 GB local NVMe SSD. Benchmark results place its single-core CPU throughput and compression rates in the top tier, while multi-core stress tests and memory bandwidth register at midrange levels consistent with its 4-core scale. The architecture incorporates advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, though no discrete GPU hardware is present. With substantial memory density per core and fast attached storage, the F8-4amds_v7 is tailored for memory-intensive enterprise tasks, in-memory databases, caching layers, and high-frequency data processing pipelines requiring strong single-thread execution and rapid local temporary storage.
